description: Register of legal clause classifications for Nexora Agreements (PROP.5). Every clause below is classified. Only AUTHORITATIVE / safely DERIVED / CLIENT_SPECIFIC information may be inserted as contractual content. LEGAL_DECISION_REQUIRED clauses must NOT appear as agreed terms — they are rendered in DRAFT Agreements as clearly marked unresolved provisions, and a READY_FOR_EXECUTION Agreement is refused while any mandatory clause remains LEGAL_DECISION_REQUIRED. This register is changed ONLY through the Commercial Constitution change-control process (Owner/legal decision).
